summary: Regenerated Quick Chat Engineering Specification and UI/UX Architecture incorporating all 10 mandatory corrections: exact 6-field registration (Name, Username, Age, Email, Password, Confirm Password), username-only login, username-centric primary identity throughout all screens and search, database-enforced username uniqueness, standard logout flow, no final seed contacts in product architecture, and pure planning/UI-UX scope without premature backend or encryption implementation.
